summary: Build risk-based safety plans, worker participation, and KPI reporting. Explore the 5-day course outline and enquire about delivery.
lede: Safety leadership training helps occupational health and safety professionals, safety managers, and operational leaders turn workplace risks into planned controls. Using ISO 45001:2018 and ILO-OSH guidance, learners practise prioritizing hazards, consulting workers, choosing controls, reviewing audit evidence, and tracking performance with safety KPIs to create leadership action plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support occupational health and safety decisions, manage workplace controls, or report safety performance to leadership.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with workplace hazard identification, incident reporting, or occupational health and safety management processes is expected. No coding or programming is required; Excel access is useful for the KPI dashboard exercise.
